scope: Read-only cause investigation plus explicitly approved, bounded 90-second controller power/control=on comparison; restore auto afterward.
confirmed: SoundWire bus clash recorded at 2026-11-13 23:56:21 KST on controller 6b10000.soundwire.
User identifies pause/video-switch followed by playback as the trigger.
Existing source already contains the October 9 IRQ disable/enable fix; adding the older synchronize_irq variant is not a demonstrated missing fix.

causal_limit: Controller runtime suspend/resume is the leading hypothesis, strengthened by user-reported A/B/A outcomes. It is not a confirmed unique cause or a specific proven code defect: only one full codec suspend/resume was captured under on; no synchronized new clash appeared during the short baseline; restored-auto video playback was outside the captured window. Old clash state, firmware/codec timing and application stream behavior remain distinguishable possibilities.
